description: 让探索、采集与建造汇成一份完整收藏。27 个目页面与总览记录 1146 种合法物品；收齐一组，再向全物品目标推进。Forge 版另有 11 页分类创造栏与进度视野保持。

mods.name: AICA - 全物品收集进度
mods.description:
将 Minecraft 1.20.1 的物品分类化为生存收集目标。
27 个目页面和 1 个总览追踪 1146 种合法物品，收齐分类全部成员即可完成进度。
创造栏按分类展示物品，属与原生变体可点击展开、折叠；保留快捷栏、搜索、生存物品栏及其他模组页。
客户端需要 MoreCreativeTabs 与 Inventory Item Groups；支持 Better Advancements。

releases.notes:
# AICA 1.3.0

Release for Minecraft Java 1.20.1. This replaces the public 1.2.0 release and includes the author's classification 1.0.0 and the interface work previously available in 1.3.0pre1.

- Rebuilt collection progress around 27 order pages and an overview: 28 roots, 721 visible advancements and 1,146 legal item IDs. Classification 1.0.0 remains unchanged: 1,656 nodes and 1,255 IDs, including 109 illegal IDs.
- Every visible category requires all its members. Hidden discovery conditions reveal branches only. Removed all advancement rewards while preserving vanilla notifications and announcements.
- Added 11 Forge creative tabs: four Material orders, six other legal classes and the illegal branch. Hotbar and Search sit at the upper right, Survival Inventory at the lower right. Other mods' tabs remain available; the old daily-redstone tab is removed.
- Added collapsible genera with three or more members and full native NBT variants. White and ominous banners now stay together inside the existing 16-colour banner genus. Feature- and permission-dependent variants remain available, including operator paintings and light levels; search keeps native variants.
- Ordered advancement pages by the classification and retained the viewed position when nodes appear, pages switch, or the screen reopens. Supports vanilla and Better Advancements 0.6.0.73.
- Preserved migration from old `all_item` and AICA 1.0.0 item criteria, existing timestamps and ZIP/JAR progress continuity. Newly imported criteria use the import date. Kept the built-in 1.20.1 bundle recipe.
- Forge target: 47.4.23 and Java 17. MoreCreativeTabs 1.2.1 and Inventory Item Groups 1.5.1-forge+1.20 are separate, mandatory **client** dependencies. Cloth Config, Better Advancements and Click Advancements remain optional.

Back up the world, remove the previous AICA package, and enable only one ZIP/JAR format per world.

---

# AICA 1.3.0 · 全物品收集进度

Minecraft Java 1.20.1 正式发布版，替代公开 1.2.0，整合作者的 1.0.0 分类及此前 1.3.0pre1 的界面功能。

- 收集进度改为 27 个目页面加总览，共 28 个页面根、721 个可见进度，覆盖 1146 种合法物品 ID。分类 1.0.0 保持不变：1656 节点、1255 ID，含非法门 109 ID。
- 所有可见分类目标均要求收齐全部成员；隐藏条件仅负责发现分支。全部进度无奖励，保留原版弹窗与广播。
- Forge 创造栏新增材料四目、其余六纲及非法门，共 11 页。快捷栏与搜索固定在右上、生存物品栏在右下；保留其他模组标签页，移除旧“生电常用”页。
- 三种及以上物品的属可折叠，原生变体保留完整 NBT。白色旗帜与不祥旗帜现在一同归入已有 16 色旗帜属；功能和权限对应的画、光源等级等变体仍可用，搜索保留原生变体。
- 进度页按分类排序，新节点出现、切页、关闭重开后保持已浏览位置；适用于原版及 Better Advancements 0.6.0.73。
- 保留旧 `all_item`、AICA 1.0.0 物品条件导入及已有日期，ZIP/JAR 切换继续使用世界中的记录；新导入条件使用导入日期。沿用原版 1.20.1 内置收纳袋配方。
- Forge 目标为 47.4.23 / Java 17。客户端另装 MoreCreativeTabs 1.2.1 和 Inventory Item Groups 1.5.1-forge+1.20；Cloth Config、Better Advancements、Click Advancements 为可选。

升级前备份世界、移走旧包；同一世界只启用 ZIP 或 JAR 一种形式。
